model_num: # Threshold report across all evaluated models (n=12)
# model_num: model number from the basename<N>.pkl sequence
# pkl_file: pkl filename that was evaluated
# is_priority: True if model met the precision/recall threshold criterion at the default 0.5 cut
# default_threshold_used: decision threshold built into the model (0.5 for LGBMClassifier.predict)
# stored_oof_threshold: Youden's J threshold computed from OOF training-set predictions at training time (loaded from sibling *_threshold.json). NaN if not available
# testset_youden_j_threshold: Youden's J threshold computed fresh on this test set (V26.05 addition). Optimistic vs OOF threshold since selection-evaluation overlap
# testset_youden_j_value: Youden's J value (TPR-FPR) at the testset_youden_j_threshold. Range [0
# test_auc: ROC AUC on the test set - discrimination quality independent of any threshold
# test_accuracy_default: overall accuracy at the default 0.5 cut
# test_accuracy_youden: overall accuracy at the test-set Youden-optimal cut
# sens_default: sensitivity (recall on positive/Win class) at default 0.5 cut
# spec_default: specificity (recall on negative/Loss class) at default 0.5 cut
# sens_youden: sensitivity at test-set Youden cut
# spec_youden: specificity at test-set Youden cut
